title: Call keys through the chat server: published keys and sealed sender keys
spec: Requests 22 CallKey { room, call, public } and 23 CallSeal { room, call, to, kid, sealed (1 to MAX_SEALED = 256 bytes) }, answered Ok with the call id, behind FEATURE_CALLS. Only someone in the call publishes a key (it counts as a heartbeat); a sealed key goes only to someone else in the call; a sender keeps at most MAX_KIDS_PER_PAIR (8) kids per recipient, the oldest dropped. Leaving forgets the person's key and every box to or from them; an ended call keeps none. Keys and boxes are not journaled. After Sync, with FEATURE_CALLS, CallState is followed by push 77 CallKeys (every participant's key) and push 78 CallSealed for each box sealed to the person syncing, and to no one else; none advance the cursor. The client inbox keeps RoomView::call_keys(call) and sealed(call), cleared when the call ends. End to end with crewcraft_sframe::seal: the recipient opens the box and decrypts the sender's SFrame frame; another participant cannot open it.
